replayAttribution: The working tree entered this issue as a replay of the reviewed AFC-1222 tip (code de7624a, SQL 29a403a, both authored on AFC-1222 and CTO-R2-approved for the SQL half). Files 0069/0070/103 above are carried unchanged from that tip so the reviewed tree is the deployable tree; authorship of those three files stays with the AFC-1222 claim. Everything else listed here — including 0071/0072, suite 104, and all route/util/config/Caddy/contract edits — is new work authored on AFC-1226.
scopeOfTheClaim: R1 only: authorship of the AFC-1226 second hardening pass (G1-G3, H1-H3, M1-M3) plus the AFC-1222 tip replay it builds on. Correctness is for CI/test:db (R4) and the CTO R2 review of the compliance-path commit. No reviews[] entry here: R2 arrives as a Reviewed-by trailer or a review record from a reviewer who is not the author.
status: R1-filed; R2 PENDING. The compliance-path files above (migrations, tests/db) cannot be committed by the author: they need a named reviewer per scripts/dirty-path-guard.sh, and the reviewer for a migration touching auth/permissions/personal data is the CTO. Non-compliance files land first; the compliance commit follows the CTO verdict.
whatTheChangeActuallyDoes: G1: 0071 makes the capacity-gate function SECURITY DEFINER owned by directus_migrator with fixed search_path so a read-less inserting identity gets event_full instead of 42501. G2: capacity pre-check rides the server token; a failing pre-check falls through to write-plus-trigger mapping. G3: 0072 revokes the 0069 public create grant (after the writer role exists), converges the registration_writer create-only grant (16 public fields + registration_status + idempotency_key, WITHOUT source/consent_signed_at), and installs the server-side consent-stamp trigger; the route writes through NUXT_DIRECTUS_WRITER_TOKEN and never sends source/consent. H1: limit key is CF-Connecting-IP or socket IP (XFF never trusted for keying; Caddy overwrites XFF at the edge), map bounded at 10000 entries, per-instance limit documented honestly. H2: Idempotency-Key stamped now; 23505 replays the original row. H3: contact filter normalized before querying; store errors fail closed (503) for seat-occupying writes. M1: honeypot returns the identical success shape with synthesized values. M2: Retry-After header on 429. M3: suite 104 probes as the read-less identity and pins 0069/0072 refusal paths.
